question: What is the admission process at Bhavya Computer Classes?
answer: You can enroll by visiting our campus in Mahaveer Nagar Extension, Kota, or by calling/WhatsApp-ing us at +91 96949 32391. We also offer an online inquiry form on our Contact page. Our team will guide you through course selection, documentation, and fee payment. Admission is open throughout the year — new batches start every month.

question: Do you provide placement assistance after course completion?
answer: Yes! We provide 100% placement assistance to all our students. We have tie-ups with local businesses, accounting firms, and IT companies in Kota and nearby cities. Our dedicated placement team helps with resume building, mock interviews, and job referrals. We also maintain an active alumni network that shares job openings.

question: Are the courses certified by a recognized authority?
answer: Yes. All our courses come with government-recognized certificates. The DCA and computer courses are affiliated with reputed certification bodies, making your qualification valid for government jobs, private sector roles, and higher education admissions in Rajasthan and across India.

question: Can I attend a free demo class before enrolling?
answer: Absolutely! We offer 2 free demo classes for all our courses — no payment or commitment required. This lets you experience our teaching style and decide if the course is the right fit for you. Just call or WhatsApp us at +91 96949 32391 to schedule your demo session.

question: What is the fee structure for the courses?
answer: Course fees vary depending on the program. Short-term courses like Basic Computer and Tally start from approximately ₹3,000. Comprehensive programs like DCA are priced higher and may include multiple modules. We also offer flexible instalment plans. Please visit the individual course page or contact us directly for the latest fee details.

question: What courses does Bhavya Computer Classes offer?
answer: We offer a wide range of computer and digital courses including: DCA (Diploma in Computer Applications), Tally Prime with GST, Python Programming, Web Designing, Digital Marketing, RSCIT, MS Office (Basic & Advanced), Advanced Excel, Data Entry, and more. Visit our All Courses page for the complete list with syllabus details.

question: What are your institute timings and working days?
answer: Our institute is open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM. We are closed on Sundays and national holidays. Batches are available in the morning (9 AM–12 PM), afternoon (12 PM–3 PM), and evening (4 PM–7 PM) to suit different schedules — including working professionals, students, and homemakers.

question: Is there an EMI or instalment option for fees?
answer: Yes, we understand that lump-sum payment may be difficult for some students. We offer flexible instalment plans for most courses. Please speak with our admissions team to discuss a payment schedule that works for you. No interest is charged on instalments.

question: What is the duration of the DCA course?
answer: The DCA (Diploma in Computer Applications) course at Bhavya Computer Classes typically runs for 6 months to 1 year, depending on the batch and specialisation. It covers MS Office, Internet & Emailing, Tally, programming basics, and more. Upon completion, you receive a government-recognised DCA certificate.

question: Is RSCIT valid for government jobs in Rajasthan?
answer: Yes, RSCIT (Rajasthan State Certificate in Information Technology) is mandatory for most government jobs in Rajasthan, including positions in state departments, police, and education sector. Over 65% of government job advertisements in Rajasthan require RSCIT as a baseline qualification. We prepare students thoroughly for the RSCIT exam.

question: Do you teach Tally Prime or Tally ERP 9?
answer: We teach Tally Prime, which is the latest and most in-demand version of Tally software. Tally Prime includes all features of Tally ERP 9 plus an updated interface, GST filing, and improved reports. We also cover GST return filing, voucher entry, inventory management, and payroll in our Tally Prime course.

question: Which courses are best after completing 12th class in Kota?
answer: After 12th class, the most job-oriented courses we offer are: (1) DCA — comprehensive 6-month diploma, (2) Tally Prime with GST — ideal for accounts/commerce students, (3) Python Programming — great for those interested in IT/software, (4) Digital Marketing — excellent for entrepreneurship or online careers, (5) RSCIT — required for Rajasthan govt jobs. Our counsellors can help you pick based on your stream and career goals.

question: Do you offer weekend batches for working professionals?
answer: Yes! We have special weekend batches (Saturday & Sunday) designed specifically for working professionals, homemakers, and anyone who can't attend on weekdays. These batches cover the same curriculum at a slightly extended pace. Please contact us to check availability and schedule.

question: Is prior computer knowledge required to join your courses?
answer: No prior computer knowledge is required for most of our beginner courses like Basic Computer, MS Office, and RSCIT. We start from the very basics — keyboard, mouse, and Windows — before moving to advanced topics. For advanced courses like Python or Web Development, basic computer literacy is helpful but not mandatory.

question: Do you provide study material and notes?
answer: Yes, all enrolled students receive comprehensive printed study material and practical exercise sheets for their course. Additionally, our student portal gives you access to digital notes, practice files, and supplementary resources that you can access from home at any time.

question: What is the student portal and how does it help me?
answer: Our student portal is a digital learning environment unique to Bhavya Computer Classes — the only computer institute in Kota to offer this feature. Through the portal, you can view your attendance, check test marks and grades, see the class calendar, submit assignments digitally, and download study material. You can access it from any device after logging in at bhavyacomputerclasses.com/login.

question: Can I get a government job after completing a course from Bhavya?
answer: Yes! Many of our students have secured government jobs after completing courses here. Our RSCIT and DCA certificates are recognised for Rajasthan state government job applications. We also help students prepare their application documents and provide reference letters if required.

question: How is Bhavya Computer Classes different from other institutes in Kota?
answer: Several things set us apart: (1) We are the only computer institute in Kota with a digital student portal, (2) government-recognised certificates since 2010, (3) 100% placement assistance with real employer connections, (4) experienced faculty with 10+ years of industry background, (5) batch timings designed for all schedules, and (6) free demo classes with no pressure. We have trained 5,000+ students over 15 years.

question: What is the location and address of Bhavya Computer Classes?
answer: We are located at 3-N-25, Mahaveer Nagar Extension, Near Ganesh Ji Mandir, Kota, Rajasthan. It is easily accessible from all major areas of Kota. You can use Google Maps to navigate by searching 'Bhavya Computer Classes Kota'. Our institute is open Monday to Saturday.

question: Do you offer online or home-based courses?
answer: Our primary teaching is done in the classroom to ensure hands-on practical training. However, through our student portal, enrolled students can access study material and notes online from home. We occasionally offer online sessions for students who miss classes due to unavoidable reasons. Contact us for more details.

question: How many students are in each batch?
answer: We maintain small batch sizes of 10–15 students per batch to ensure personalised attention for every student. This means our faculty can address individual doubts and track each student's progress closely — unlike large institutes where students get lost in a crowd.

question: What documents are required for admission?
answer: For admission, you typically need: (1) a passport-size photograph, (2) a photocopy of your last educational qualification (10th/12th marksheet or certificate), (3) an Aadhaar card or any government ID. Additional documents may be required for specific certification courses. Our admissions team will guide you through the exact requirements.

question: Do you provide a refund if I decide to leave a course midway?
answer: Our fee refund policy depends on the timing and circumstances. If you withdraw within the first week of joining, a partial refund may be available after deducting administrative costs. After that, fees are generally non-refundable. However, we are always willing to discuss course transfers or schedule adjustments if you are facing difficulties. Please speak to our team directly.

question: What is Digital Marketing and what are its career prospects?
answer: Digital Marketing covers online advertising, SEO (Search Engine Optimization), social media marketing, email campaigns, and Google Ads. It is one of the fastest-growing career fields — every business, small or large, needs digital marketing professionals today. After completing this course, you can work for companies, freelance, or even market your own business online.

question: Does Python programming help in getting jobs?
answer: Yes, Python is one of the most in-demand programming languages globally and is used in web development, data analysis, artificial intelligence, and automation. In Kota, local IT firms and outsourcing companies actively hire Python developers. It is also highly valued for remote and freelance work opportunities.
